RF_Thunderbreak_Command.text: Thunderbreak command — a broad, disciplined heavy-cruiser bridge organized around a central command position, active tactical and navigation stations, large shared operational displays, and visible evidence of an older ship repeatedly repaired rather than cosmetically renewed. Crew movement should preserve clear station geography across returns.
RF_Thunderbreak_Command.name: Thunderbreak command

RF_Admiralty_Tribunal.text: Fleet Admiralty tribunal — formal Core hearing space built to make hierarchy legible: elevated circular authority positions, a lower testimony floor, controlled evidence displays, restrained stone-metal geometry, and very little visual clutter. Evidence that disrupts institutional neatness should remain physically visible once introduced.
RF_Admiralty_Tribunal.name: Fleet Admiralty tribunal

RF_Relic_Court.text: Relic Court — monumental Core political chamber with bright stone, restrained banners, long sightlines, a central working table for documents and live operational feeds, and enough open floor that who joins or refuses the table is visually meaningful.
RF_Relic_Court.name: Relic Court

RF_Auric_Civic_Core.text: Auric civic and operations complex — practical Verge government space embedded in a working freeport: scuffed tables, cargo and ration boards, public-facing displays, doors opening toward active docks, and officials working close to clerks, residents and freight rather than behind ceremonial barriers.
RF_Auric_Civic_Core.name: Auric civic and operations complex

RF_Auric_Luxury_Ring.text: Auric luxury ring / Crown Ring — formerly expensive residential concourse converted into unstable public shelter: chandeliers and high-end finishes coexist with bedding, heaters, ration lines, temporary partitions and a large cracked observation window under continuous structural watch.
RF_Auric_Luxury_Ring.name: Auric luxury ring / Crown Ring

RF_Veil_Market.text: Veil Market — dense lived-in trade network of stalls, broker rooms, back passages and route boards with practical worklight, handwritten or chalk navigation information, layered signage and enough physical wear that commerce, refuge and rumor visibly share the same infrastructure.
RF_Veil_Market.name: Veil Market

RF_Gravefire_Interior.text: Gravefire interior — compact Shard working ship maintained through visible repair rather than ceremony: tight stations, patched pale industrial surfaces, narrow bright-red faction markings, restrained lighting, and a cockpit/bridge geography that favors practical sightlines over spectacle.
RF_Gravefire_Interior.name: Gravefire interior

RF_Arena_Vault.text: Shardfall Arena Vault — vast circular Shard political chamber of pale industrial structure, bright-red control markings and dark forge-adjacent depth. Empty tiers and tactical displays should make absence of public support as visible as a crowd would be; the three Triarch masks occupy distinct, repeatable positions.
RF_Arena_Vault.name: Shardfall Arena Vault

RF_Tal_Corvus_Warrens.text: Tal Corvus warrens — dense inhabited industrial passages carved through damp, worn infrastructure: narrow routes, practical heat and supply hardware, improvised chalk guidance, layered family habitation and recurring seams where anomaly seep can become visible without turning the space mystical.
RF_Tal_Corvus_Warrens.name: Tal Corvus warrens

RF_Shatterforge.text: Shatterforge — enormous inhabited forge complex where ember furnaces, vent trunks, exposed bridges, blade-production halls and family quarters occupy the same vertical industrial system. Safety hardware and service vents must retain readable geography because later damage depends on where they connect.
RF_Shatterforge.name: Shatterforge

RF_Auric_Gate.text: Auric Gate — large reciprocal-field transit installation of ember-orange pylons, stability rims, shared timing boards and civilian approach lanes. Preserve the relationship between pylons, central crossing lane, traffic-control positions and shield approaches so battle and later Accord operations read as the same place.
RF_Auric_Gate.name: Auric Gate

RF_Luminara_Fields_Dock.text: Luminara Fields agricultural freight dock — a bright productive Verge port embedded in cultivated land, with practical loading cranes, fabric shade, food sacks, long tan-and-muted-green farm freighters, families and workers sharing the same civic-industrial space.
RF_Luminara_Fields_Dock.name: Luminara Fields agricultural freight dock

RF_Kaldr_Rift.text: Kaldr Rift — a hazardous convoy passage through dense asteroid fragments, broken industrial structures and old hull wreckage. Navigation depends on physical spacing, sightlines and maneuvering through debris; never render it as a magical tunnel or portal.
RF_Kaldr_Rift.name: Kaldr Rift

RF_Verge_Escort_Cockpit.text: Verge escort cockpit — cramped, worn and practical, with physical controls, patched tan-and-muted-green surfaces, broad forward visibility and just enough instrumentation to fly working routes. It should feel maintained and heavily used rather than primitive or dirty.
RF_Verge_Escort_Cockpit.name: Verge escort cockpit

RF_Luminara_Freighter_Hold.text: Luminara farm-freighter cargo hold — tall working freight volume built around strapped agricultural crates, utility rails, emergency helmets and pressure doors. Civilian passengers share the same functional space with cargo, making hull breaches and boarding actions immediately human-scale.
RF_Luminara_Freighter_Hold.name: Luminara farm-freighter cargo hold

RF_Thunderbreak_Memorial_Deck.text: Thunderbreak memorial deck — bright disciplined Fleet remembrance hall with a circular gathering floor, restrained blue-and-gold insignia, engraved casualty walls and a central geometric memorial. Treat it as service infrastructure for remembering losses, not a shrine or mystical sanctuary.
RF_Thunderbreak_Memorial_Deck.name: Thunderbreak memorial deck

RF_Auric_Bazaar.text: Auric Bazaar — a dense but capable Verge freeport market and dock ring where cargo, food, route trade, civic relief and ordinary family life overlap. Use tan-and-muted-green working infrastructure, fabric shade, freight hardware and practical night or daylight illumination without portraying the Verge as backward.
RF_Auric_Bazaar.name: Auric Bazaar

RF_Black_Drift_Repair_Yard.text: Black Drift Shard repair yard — inhabited asteroid-industrial dock where damaged Shard ships are maintained by large working crews using visible welding, salvaged components, pressure hardware and communal labor. Pale industrial layers and bright-red markings coexist with meals, families and lived-in repair culture.
RF_Black_Drift_Repair_Yard.name: Black Drift Shard repair yard

RF_Black_Drift_Hangar.text: Black Drift hangar floor — bright functional Shard work bay around compact craft, cargo nets, parts benches and active repair stations. White/pale-gray industrial surfaces, dark underlayers and strong red markings make faction identity clear without pirate-barbarian styling.
RF_Black_Drift_Hangar.name: Black Drift hangar floor

RF_Shard_Command_Room.text: Shard command room — practical pale industrial planning space centered on a physical terrain/route table, repair hardware and crew standing close to the work. Bright-red faction markings remain restrained; tactical planning should read as operational engineering rather than magical projection.
RF_Shard_Command_Room.name: Shard command room

RF_Triarch_Chamber.text: Silent Triarch chamber — dark Shard political command room with three fixed authority positions for three distinct masks, practical route and status displays, pale industrial ceremonial layers and bright-red control markings. The Triarch are institutional rulers, never supernatural figures.
RF_Triarch_Chamber.name: Silent Triarch chamber

RF_Core_Admiralty_Chamber.text: Core Admiralty chamber — luminous formal Fleet decision space with white stone-metal geometry, deep-navy banners, elevated authority positions, a circular floor route display and a large shared corridor map. Institutional hierarchy is visibly spacious and orderly; green lanes appear only as measured navigation geometry.
RF_Core_Admiralty_Chamber.name: Core Admiralty chamber

RF_Shard_Assembly_Orbit.text: Shard assembly orbit — dark inhabited industrial stronghold surrounded by numerous working Shard vessels and a foreground observation platform. Mobilization is communicated through ships lighting ordinary engines and taking formation, not ritual energy or supernatural effects.
RF_Shard_Assembly_Orbit.name: Shard assembly orbit
